annotation.title_clean: 关于印发医疗康复护理扩容提升工程实施方案的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Medical Rehabilitation and Nursing Capacity Expansion and Improvement Project
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委; 国家发展改革委 (National Health Commission; National Development and Reform Commission)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese national plan, approved by the State Council, to expand medical rehabilitation and nursing services by 2030. It is mainly about health system capacity and workforce, with brief provisions promoting AI-plus-rehabilitation, rehabilitation robots, wearables, brain-computer interfaces and embodied intelligence R&D.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target of 0.48 rehabilitation/nursing beds per 1,000 people and a fully built service system by 2030.
Develop 'AI + rehabilitation nursing' using rehabilitation robots and smart wearables.
Accelerate brain-computer interface, embodied intelligence and bionic drive technologies; priority review for innovative devices.
Expand workforce training, with 0.7 rehabilitation physicians and 1.6 therapists per 10,000 people.
Strengthen quality standards, product quality supervision and insurance/payment reform.
